column1:
Welcome to the Composer Equipment tab. This part of the sheet aims to document the equipment used by various composers. 
This documentation exists to make research easier, offering a much clearer overview of what a certain artist could have used in their music.

Equipment Shared by Squaresoft in 1991-2000 (Nobuo Uematsu, Yasunori Mitsuda, Yoko Shimomura, Kenji Ito, Hiroki Kikuta, Junya Nakano, Masashi Hamauzu, Tsuyoshi Sekito, Hitoshi Sakimoto, Masaharu Iwata, Takahito Eguchi, Kenichiro Fukui)
